text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Guess what, Trainer? An older student complimented me on my running the other day!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: She said that having a younger student like me around nipping at her heels is motivating her to focus and work harder!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Maybe that means I'm slowly edging towards being the top Umamusume in all of Japan! Hehe, but who knows for sure, right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ever since I met you, I've grown to love running even more!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Here's to even more years together, Trainer!
